recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for FHIR-core. Any further Citation example additions or example-detail cleanup should be reconciled in the HL7 EBM IG source rather than reintroducing core Citation example files.
issue_request: FHIR-31643 was a Published/Persuasive CDS technical correction for FHIR-core-Citation requesting complete Citation Resource examples because the R4B-era example page appeared to be only a placeholder.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-31643 was found. The request appears to have been applied in the former core Citation source by commits such as a519c04228cfe36a06fc82ef797d78c4f8352a16, which added citation-example-systematic-meta-review and updated list-Citation-examples.xml, and e3baacba23b0f32cb9abb32147bb104091928413, which added additional Citation examples.
additional_context: Citation is no longer an active FHIR-core resource. Commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed source/citation and active Citation configuration, and current core narrative says Citation moved to the Evidence Based Medicine on FHIR IG. The EBM IG artifacts page lists many Citation examples, but current core links to the moved resource used a 404 StructureDefinition-Citation.html URL.
reconciliation: Changed the current core Citation references from https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/ebm/StructureDefinition-Citation.html to https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/ebm/citation.html in the relevant narrative and history source files. No source/citation files were restored because Citation examples are now outside this core build.
